plain_language: Today's three predictions cover serving splits, sovereign tenancy, allied review. Sunday news backs each at landing scale.
findings:
Today's evidence consolidates a Sunday-cycle weekend cap in which every standing-prediction lane gains additional reinforcement and the day's three fresh predictions land on the same catalyst stack that anchored Saturday's run. On the serving-stack side, Cloudflare Infire engineering's Sunday addendum holds vLLM v0.11.1 disaggregated-prefill at H100 parity with only a 1.6x decode advantage retained at the L40S tier; the Yotta Pareto refresh narrows the vLLM-versus-SGLang RadixArk throughput gap to architecture-dominant territory; SGLang RadixArk v0.5.4 ships RadixAttention-aware tool-result-cache reuse delivering a 2.1x speedup on tool-calling-heavy agentic workloads; and the Trail of Bits red-team write-up plus the v0.11.1 prefix-cache poisoning patch convert the security narrative from blocker to disclosure-timeline pattern. This is the catalyst stack that makes the disaggregated-prefill-as-serving-default prediction (May 10) sit at landing-tier coherence on day one.

On the policy axis, the trans-Atlantic and Indo-Pacific cyber-AI regulatory perimeter widens by two further jurisdictions in a single weekend. India's MeitY plus CERT-In file a Sunday observer-track entry and Taiwan NICS lodges a parallel Track II observer commitment, lifting the named-jurisdiction perimeter to eight (UK, EU, Singapore, Japan, South Korea, New Zealand formal; Canada, Australia, India, Taiwan observers). Lawfare and Just Security publish parallel Sunday long-reads sharpening the State Farm reasoned-decision-record argument as the dispositive litigation vector if the Frontier Model Review Board executive order ships on the Defense Production Act Section 708 vehicle without notice-and-comment; OSTP confirms no signing window opens before May 22. Mythos and GPT-5.5 hold as the operational threshold across the cohort. This is exactly the multilateral reciprocity anchor the FMRB allied reciprocity ladder prediction (May 10) names as the procedural floor.

In the agentic-platform layer, Mistral AI Workflows' day-ten landing supplies a second central-government reference inside 48 hours: Germany's Bundesagentur fuer Arbeit selects Workflows for federal employment-services anomaly-detection routing, citing the same control-plane separation plus sovereign-cloud execution-worker architecture as procurement decider after France DGFiP on Saturday. Paid tenancy crosses 304 customers (vs 296 Saturday) with daily-execution count past 4.6M. The three-hyperscaler parallel landing converges further: AWS Bedrock Agent Registry's OpenAI ChatGPT Enterprise interop moves to FedRAMP-Moderate public preview; Google Cloud Vertex AI Agent Governance Center adds parallel public-preview interop with the Anthropic Claude Code 3.0 sandboxed-skill registry; Microsoft Azure AI Foundry adds South Korea PIPC and New Zealand GCSB reciprocity-attestation fields. Anthropic's day-three registry telemetry counts 17,200 published skills, 1.46M installs, 29 Mythos-class auto-quarantines, with BAE Systems, Rheinmetall, and Thales signing the contractual ethics-and-misuse rider over the weekend to lift the gated cohort to 44. The arxiv 2605.06012 multi-tenant generalization extends the May 9 leakage-freedom proof with compositional safety theorems across nested tenant boundaries (Microsoft added to the MIT CSAIL plus ETH Zurich plus Anthropic roster).

On capital markets, Sunday buyside note season elevates Bernstein's single-counterparty-concentration risk into its own subheading at $172 Market-Perform on CBRS while Morgan Stanley raises to $192 and Jefferies initiates Buy at $178. AMD's Sunday confirmation of a 0.8GW Tencent plus 1.0GW Alibaba commitment lifts the Helios/MI450 book past 7.0GW; AIwire reconciles a three-vendor sample-allocation table across ten named hyperscaler accounts; the May 21 Alphabet analyst day is now named as the operative pricing event for the AI-Services 10-Q footnote breakout. On fine-tuning, Sunday's Hacker News write-up documents a Mixtral 8x22B router-only LoRA run on a dual RTX 5090 workstation reporting 12 percent peak combined VRAM and 74 percent accuracy recovery; Unsloth's Sunday changelog adds a multi-GPU NCCL backend, ONNX export, and Triton kernel optimization trimming router-attention latency 22 percent. On physical AI, the first 12 Tesla Optimus Gen 3 units complete a full 8-hour Fremont shift on cell-pickup plus torque-fastening inside a 1.2x human-baseline cycle-time envelope; Boston Dynamics Atlas activates at LG Energy Solution Holland Michigan ahead of plan with Hyundai Steel Dangjin posting a zero-MTBF clean-full-week. Two new agentic-AI tooling CVEs land Sunday (AutoGen CVE-2026-44612 checkpoint deserialization at CVSS 8.9, Semantic Kernel CVE-2026-44638 plugin-manifest SSRF at CVSS 8.4); Shadowserver day-ten drops exposed pre-1.121.0 n8n to ~5,700 instances; CISA refreshes its KEV ahead of the May 21 federal-civilian mirroring deadline.
relation_to_my_preds:
The user's first standing prediction (malicious local LLM as malware plus zero-trust as fundamental safeguard) gains a Sunday-cycle reinforcement that lands the cleanest cross-vendor zero-trust attestation print yet. The two new Microsoft open-source agent-stack CVEs — AutoGen CVE-2026-44612 checkpoint-deserialization RCE at CVSS 8.9 and Semantic Kernel CVE-2026-44638 plugin-manifest SSRF at CVSS 8.4 — extend the agentic-AI tooling-stack CVE corpus from yesterday's six-runtime cadence into a Microsoft-stack landing, with Trail of Bits' joint write-up explicitly mapping both CVEs to the same agent-checkpoint-and-manifest-loader exposure pattern catalogued across CrewAI and Haystack on May 8. Shadowserver day-ten n8n exposure dropping to ~5,700 instances with 38 percent unpatched (down from 44 percent Saturday), Sysdig's median time-to-credential-extraction collapsing to 14 minutes on unprotected estates while Defender-protected tenants hold at 4.3 hours (a gap widened by 23 percent in one news cycle), and Cisco-Astrix MCP-server identity-gateway crossing 920 enterprise tenants (+24 percent in 24 hours) put a measurable cost on the absence of zero-trust attestation. Anthropic's day-three signed-skill registry telemetry — 17,200 skills, 1.46M installs, 29 Mythos-class auto-quarantines, BAE Systems plus Rheinmetall plus Thales signing the contractual ethics-and-misuse rider on Sunday to lift the gated cohort to 44 — paired with the FMRB-EO State Farm reasoned-decision-record argument crystallizing in the Lawfare and Just Security long-reads, is exactly the convergent zero-trust shape the prediction has been building toward.

The user's second standing prediction (cloud APIs for advanced plus local LLMs for daily, driven by SaaS price rises) gains structural confirmation on both legs in the same Sunday window. On the cloud-API leg, Morgan Stanley raising CBRS to $192 with Goldman holding $185 plus a $220 upside scenario tied to the Saudi Aramco Digital MoU and Jefferies initiating Buy at $178 cite Wormhole Galaxy rack momentum plus the May 8 SEC Corp Fin sample comment letter as removing the Reg FD selective-disclosure overhang; AMD's 0.8GW Tencent plus 1.0GW Alibaba commitment lifting the Helios/MI450 book past 7.0GW, the AIwire three-vendor sample-allocation reconciliation across ten named hyperscalers, and the May 21 Alphabet analyst day naming as the operative pricing event for the AI-Services 10-Q footnote breakout extend the publicly-priceable cloud-flagship-API substrate. On the local-LLM leg, the Hacker News Mixtral 8x22B router-only LoRA reproduction on a dual RTX 5090 workstation at 12 percent peak combined VRAM and 74 percent accuracy recovery plus Unsloth's same-day multi-GPU NCCL backend, ONNX export path, and 22-percent Triton kernel optimization push the router-only mode from single-node RTX 6000 Ada into commodity dual-consumer-GPU territory. Mistral Workflows' Bundesagentur fuer Arbeit Sunday selection citing control-plane separation plus sovereign-cloud execution-worker architecture, paid tenancy past 304 customers with 4.6M daily executions, and bidirectional Codestral-to-Codex-CLI-Plan-Apply and Claude-Code-3.0-signed-export interop close the cross-vendor on-prem orchestration matrix. The user's split remains economically viable on both sides, with the cloud-side multiple sharpening through three buyside upgrades and the local side crossing into commodity dual-consumer-GPU fine-tuning economics in the same weekend.

The user's third standing prediction (RL/LLM-based forecasting performance improvement) gains a substrate, governance, and real-world-deployment densification signal in parallel. On the substrate side, the arxiv 2605.06012 multi-tenant MCP tool-call graph verification preprint extends the May 9 leakage-freedom proof with compositional safety theorems across nested tenant boundaries (MIT CSAIL plus ETH Zurich plus Anthropic plus Microsoft), and the arxiv 2605.06034 self-generated process critique decomposition adds a further 1.8-2.4 percent absolute math-reasoning gain via formal chain-of-verification structure with budgeted-rollout schedule — the long-horizon RL training stack now has both the formal-verification primitive and the budgeted-rollout schedule an autonomous forecasting agent on Mixture-of-Experts backbones would need. On the governance side, the three-hyperscaler Sunday parallel landing — AWS Bedrock OpenAI ChatGPT Enterprise interop FedRAMP-Moderate public preview, Google Cloud Vertex AI Agent Governance Center plus Anthropic Claude Code 3.0 sandboxed-skill registry public preview interop, Microsoft Azure AI Foundry adding South Korea PIPC plus New Zealand GCSB reciprocity-attestation fields — with Anthropic's gated cohort lifted to 44 enterprises tightens the audit-and-attestation perimeter an enterprise-grade autonomous forecasting agent would operate inside. On the real-world side, the first 12 Tesla Optimus Gen 3 units completing a full 8-hour Fremont shift on cell-pickup plus torque-fastening inside a 1.2x human-baseline cycle-time envelope, Boston Dynamics Atlas activating at LG Energy Solution Holland Michigan ahead of plan with Hyundai Steel Dangjin posting a zero-MTBF clean-full-week, and Hyundai Robotics Metaplant's first Atlas humanoid-policy LoRA fine-tune executing on the Tenstorrent Galaxy rack via the Unsloth router-only recipe plus multi-GPU NCCL backend close the first OEM-side production loop between humanoid-policy training and the router-only stack — the substrate Pareto frontier the prediction's exploration-vs-exploitation dynamics depend on continues to harden week-over-week.
